rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: Sunday — US equity/ETF markets closed, so spot crypto is the only tradable universe. Tape is mildly constructive: BTC rebounded off the ~$59k area as buyers stepped in, recovering toward $63k, though weekly declines across majors remain notable and crypto has not tracked the AI-equity bid. No fresh single-name catalyst over the weekend; the setup is a bounce-off-support consolidation rather than a breakout. Long spot BTC is the most downside-protected way to hold 24h exposure while the market coils.
positions.driver: LONG spot BTC-USD (unleveraged, 100% capital). Weekend rules forbid leveraged/equity vehicles, so the choice is among spot BTC/ETH/SOL. Re-selected BTC as the lowest-vol, deepest-liquidity, most-downside-protected instrument on a low-edge weekend — exactly the 'park in lower-vol/spot' mandate — after it rebounded off ~$59k support with buyers stepping in. No leverage available/warranted with no fresh catalyst; hard 10% spot stop caps loss. Runners-up: SOL (passed — strongest forward catalyst stack via spot-SOL-ETF inflows >$1B + Firedancer/Alpenglow, but higher beta into a still-weak weekly tape, so more downside risk); ETH (passed — higher beta, pinned near resistance, no fresh edge).
positions.risks: Directional risk into an uncertain weekend: crypto trades 24/7, so a weekend liquidity air-pocket or renewed macro/geopolitical headline can gap BTC back toward — and through — the 56798.50 stop before Monday rotation. Weekly trend is still soft, so the bounce could fail. Mitigant: BTC is the least volatile major, spot avoids leverage decay, and the position sits above reclaimed support where risk/reward favors continuation of the bounce.
